name: My Furniture Warehouse Alexander
old_description: Central Arkansas' Original & Leading Furniture & Mattress Warehouse. Name brand, direct from factory, at huge savings.
about:
My Furniture Warehouse operates from a showroom at 16220 Alexander Road in Alexander, Arkansas, serving the greater Little Rock metropolitan area including the communities of Alexander and Bryant. The business is family-owned and operated by the Maness family, who have roots in the Benton and Bryant area. The company positions itself as Central Arkansas' original furniture and mattress warehouse, though a specific founding year is not disclosed.

The retailer carries a range of name-brand home furnishings sourced directly from manufacturers, including bedroom sets, living room collections, dining room suites, and mattresses. Inventory is maintained in a warehouse format that allows the company to minimize overhead costs. The showroom provides a physical space for customers to evaluate products before purchase, supported by staff who assist with selection and design coordination.

The primary customer base consists of residential buyers throughout Central Arkansas seeking affordable, quality furniture for new homes or upgrades. The company emphasizes financing flexibility, offering multiple payment options to accommodate varying budgets. Its service area extends across the Little Rock region, with the Alexander location drawing shoppers from surrounding communities.

The Maness family states that the business was built on a commitment to honest dealing and customer-first service, maintaining a low-overhead model to pass factory-direct savings to buyers. They describe their approach as providing the same high-quality products and service as larger competitors while retaining the personal attention of a small, family-run operation.
